headline: IRGC claims Iran attacked US military base in Jordan
summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reports casualties following a strike on a US base, while the Pentagon admits nearly 100 US troops were injured over two weeks.

headline_marked: Govt [[announces 2027 Hajj packages]], cuts airfare by Tk24,830
headline: Govt announces 2027 Hajj packages, cuts airfare by Tk24,830
summary: The government has introduced three new Hajj packages for 2027, featuring reduced airfare to make the pilgrimage more affordable.
details: The Bangladesh government has officially announced the Hajj packages for the year 2027. The announcement was made by the Minister of Religious Affairs during a press conference at the Secretariat on July 21.
A key highlight of the new packages is the reduction in airfare. According to the reports, airfare has been decreased by Tk24,830, making the pilgrimage more accessible for aspiring pilgrims.
The government has introduced three different Hajj packages to provide options based on the budget and facilities provided to the pilgrims.
These measures are aimed at ensuring a better and more affordable experience for for those performing the Hajj pilgrimage from Bangladesh.
caption:
Hajj airfare is down by Tk24,830! The government has announced three new packages for 2027.

The Bangladesh government has officially announced the Hajj packages for the year 2027. The announcement was made by the Minister of Religious Affairs during a press conference at the Secretariat on July 21.

A key highlight of the new packages is the reduction in airfare. According to the reports, airfare has been decreased by Tk24,830, making the pilgrimage more accessible for aspiring pilgrims.

The government has introduced three different Hajj packages to provide options based on the budget and facilities provided to the pilgrims.

These measures are aimed at ensuring a better and more affordable experience for for those performing the Hajj pilgrimage from Bangladesh.

#Hajj2027 #Bangladesh #Pilgrimage #GovtUpdate #ReligiousAffairs
